title: Intel Community News | Parsons Launches AresNXT
summary: On July 8, Parsons Corporation announced the launch of AresNXT, a next-generation biometrics platform designed to enable secure, scalable identity management across critical infrastructure, national security operations, and large-scale events. The post Intel Community News | Parsons Launches AresNXT appeared first on Parsons Corporation .
